t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Swap gnome colours at the start to see which one(s) give better rewards. At some point the reward structure will swap, at this point swap all of your colour choices to get the better rewards.

vb_textbox.text: At the start switch gnomes often so you can see which coloured gnomes give the most mushrooms. Once you know which gnomes are best keep picking those. Soon after these gnomes will start giving you less mushrooms, at this point change the gnome colours you are selecting to maximise mushrooms again. Keep doing this until the experiment ends. Good luck!
